arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python3 << 'EOF'
from parse import Parser

# Check what happens with width and alignment
cases = [
    '{:<}',
    '{:<10}',
    '{:d}',
    '{:d}',
    '{:<5d}',
    '{:.^}',
    '{:.^5}',
]

for fmt in cases:
    p = Parser(fmt, case_sensitive=True)
    print(f"{fmt!r:15} -> expr: {p._expression}")
EOF
